items.title: Kerala HC orders clearance of trash along highway till Kalamassery; will inspect Brahmapuram waste plant
items.summary: The Kerala High Court on Friday ordered clearance of waste from identified dumping hotspot in Kochi [Suo Motu v State of Kerala] A Division Bench of Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas and Justice P Gopinath directed the State government to instruct panchayats and municipalities, through which the National Highway 966 passes till Kalamassery municipality, to clear accumulated waste from either side of the road. Pertinently, the Court said that it will be visiting the Brahmapuram waste treatment facility for a physical inspection on September 11 to verify whether it is functioning effectively. The Court said the waste dumped on roads belongs to the government or civil authorities and emphasised their duty to keep public places clean. The Court passed the order in a suo motu case initiated by the High Court to address the issue of waste management in the city. Justice P Gopinath and Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas Justice Thomas expressed concern over continued dumping of waste at various locations in Kochi.
